observationModes.Raw: Unmodified test file, no harness, no directive prepended. Diagnoses parse/runtime support only; never a conformance result.

readinessValues.runtime-semantics-observed: Body ran to the expected outcome in Raw or Probe mode on the TS-017A build; blocked only by harness/adapter prerequisites.
readinessValues.parse-rejection-observed: Parse-negative test; Rift rejects for the specified reason (not an unsupported-syntax diagnostic).
readinessValues.semantics-supported-not-run: Tested semantics are in the TS-017A feature inventory, but the file could not run because of syntax/harness gaps.
readinessValues.post-baseline: Needs a feature accepted after TS-017A; observed at head.
readinessValues.deferred: Several prerequisites outside the current subset.

globals: ReferenceError (constructor identity of the thrown value)
entries.expectation: Reading a script-level let binding in a statement before its declaration throws ReferenceError at runtime, not at parse time.
blockers: Default harness (assert.js, sta.js) must be prepended and does not parse in the subset.
Thrown value must be a ReferenceError object; Rift throws a diagnostic record named ReferenceError, not an Error instance.
entries.why: Smallest TDZ check with no helper calls; the observed diagnostic phase and name already match.
